reviews.text: Fun and educational lessons. I always went to training with great pleasure.

Suus is an incredibly sweet and dedicated woman who teaches her courses with great pleasure and passion. The lessons are educational, clear, and there is always a friendly atmosphere. She is also always ready to answer questions. We have now taken three courses with Suus and are extremely satisfied. We will definitely come back for our next dog. Highly recommended!

After a pleasant interaction with Suus, we started the puppy course with our dog at Loebas Dog School.

The atmosphere is great, Suus is very knowledgeable, and our dog loves learning.

We have now completed 3 courses and have learned a lot while having a lot of fun!

Highly recommended for your loyal four-legged friend!
Thank you for the 5 stars! 🌟 It's great to see that you are satisfied :-) …
Great (puppy) training and practical, handy, and effective tips! Highly recommended.
A very nice dog school with good tips and advice for raising our puppy.

Suus is a fantastic, calm, and experienced dog trainer. We have had two private training sessions for our adopted dog and always leave with good tips and a lot of confidence. I can recommend her to everyone!

Suus (and assistants), thank you so much for the puppy training! It was very nice to go through various exercises in a small group. You paid attention to everyone and explained everything very clearly. We definitely recommend this dog school!!

We are very happy with the content and guidance in this course! Thanks to the smaller 'classes', you receive a lot of personalized guidance. I really appreciate the approach where you, as an owner, are trained to truly understand your dog, and the focus on rewarding positive aspects. We will definitely continue training for a while longer!

I'm so glad I chose Loebas dog training school to train my dog. The groups aren't too large, and you have plenty of space to practice with your dog. Suus guides you through the varied exercises and provides useful information about dog behavior. While she teaches the whole group, she still manages to personalize the lesson and offer adjustments or instructions tailored to your dog's needs at that moment. It's clear she has a wealth of knowledge, attention, and love for her profession and the dogs!
Thank you so much for your 5 stars!
Great course, very happy with it.
Thank you very much for the stars!
The lessons are useful, I can usually easily repeat the exercises at home and, last but not least, Suus combines her tips with the necessary humor! And oh yes, Fifi loves her!
Excellent communication and always helpful. Highly recommended!
Thank you for your lovely star rating. I look forward to seeing you again soon at dog school with your smart dog Tofu!
